subject: spanish
title: Stamp 3: Spanish Media Landscape
welcome_lead: Stamp Spanish-language press and social media.
meta_desc: A-Level Spanish adventure on Spanish press, social media, and digital communication.

concepts.def: The press; major Spanish dailies include El Pais, El Mundo, ABC, La Vanguardia.
Social networks: Instagram, TikTok, X dominate; WhatsApp is the main messaging app.
Journalism; press freedom is protected by Article 20 of the Constitution.
TV news bulletins on public (TVE) and private (Antena 3, Telecinco) channels.
Fourth estate; the press as a check on government.
Hoaxes and disinformation; growing concern in digital communication.

walkthroughs.body_html: El Pais (centre-left, Madrid), El Mundo (centre-right), ABC (conservative), La Vanguardia (Catalonia). Print circulation has fallen; digital editions dominate.
Spanish politicians use X and TikTok extensively. New parties such as Vox built reach through digital communication. Bulos spread quickly via WhatsApp, especially during elections.
El periodista = journalist. El reportaje = report. La entrevista = interview. El editorial = editorial. La libertad de prensa = press freedom.
